title: AdapterUsageRow
description: One line of outbox/usage.jsonl written by an adapter. The control plane normalizes these rows into the request ledger.

step.description: 1-based step inside the run; absent for one-shot requests.

model_id.description: Real provider model id; `model` is the config alias.

tool_names.description: Tool names the model called at this step (excluding finish).

write_paths.description: Paths written as whole files at this step (edit does not count).

rewrite_count.description: Number of repeated whole-file overwrites of already-written files at this step.

history_bytes.description: Serialized history size in bytes before projection.

projected_bytes.description: Serialized history size in bytes actually sent.
